description: This file is a shell script that defines functions for checking and repairing ext2, ext3, and ext4 filesystems using e2fsck. It modifies a list of known filesystem types and logs status messages.

methods.name: fsck_e2fsck
methods.description: Performs filesystem check and repair using e2fsck for a specified device, handling different statuses and logging accordingly.

methods.name: fsck_ext2
methods.description: Wrapper function that invokes fsck_e2fsck for ext2 filesystem checks.

methods.name: fsck_ext3
methods.description: Wrapper function that invokes fsck_e2fsck for ext3 filesystem checks.

methods.name: fsck_ext4
methods.description: Wrapper function that invokes fsck_e2fsck for ext4 filesystem checks.
